d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding:bihar men ek aisi shahi shadi ki taiyari chal rahi hai, jiski charcha ab rajniti se lekar samajik galiyaron tak ho rahi hai.... shadi ke lie 10 bigha jamin par intjam, videshon se phul mangane ki taiyari, mehmanon ke lie bhavy vyavastha aur maidan men ghurdaur ka aayojan....lekin is puri kahani men sabse bara saval hai.... aakhir kaun hain vo shakhs jo mokama ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ke damad banne ja rahe hain...aur aakhir kyon is shadi ko lekar itni charcha ho rahi hai...aaie aapko batate hain anant sinh ke parivar men hone ja rahi is shahi shadi ki…
